base: Inventory value of property for which the personal representative is accountable, less mortgages or liens, plus net principal gains (Wis. Stat. § 857.05(2)).

schedules.who: Personal representative commission (Wis. Stat. § 857.05(2)) (default rate; court approval)
schedules.text: 2% (or a rate agreed in writing with the decedent or majority beneficiaries), subject to court approval, plus extraordinary services (Wis. Stat. § 857.05(2)).
schedules.capNote: Default statutory rate; may be reduced for dereliction.
